title: Loanwords: origin and accepted Aruban form

fields.name: origin
fields.description: Language of origin: nl, en, es, fr, pt, it (Italian), la (Latin), de (German), or other. other means the origin is not known; the row's notes say what was checked. AB 2018 §12.2 lists Dutch, English and French words together without saying which language each comes from, so the origins of those rows come from a dictionary or, for brand names, the brand owner, cited in the notes. A brand name gets the language of the brand's country (the US brands in §12.2 list d are en).

fields.name: original
fields.description: Spelling in the language of origin

fields.name: accepted
fields.description: Whether the loan is accepted in writing

fields.name: reviewed_by
fields.description: GitHub usernames of the reviewers, separated by '; '. Required when status is reviewed.

fields.name: page
fields.description: Printed page number(s), e.g. 38 or 38-39, roman for front matter.
